subject: Television & Streaming
title: What Streaming Took from Us
description: A fast breakdown of What Streaming Took from Us for builders.

hook.text: Streaming gave us everything we wanted: any show, any time, no ads. It also took things we didn't know we needed.

buildup.text: We lost surprise. Algorithms show us exactly what we like, so we never stumble onto something unexpected.

discovery.text: We lost patience. Binge culture trained us to expect instant gratification. Waiting became intolerable.

twist.text: We lost shared moments. When everyone watches alone, culture fragments into millions of tiny bubbles.

climax.text: Streaming solved television's biggest problems and accidentally created new ones nobody anticipated.

punchline.text: We got everything on demand and lost something irreplaceable.

quiz.question: What cultural loss does the topic attribute to the rise of streaming?
options: The decline of shared viewing experiences and cultural moments
